notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (knowledge search for customer docs). Product teams evaluating Hosted API first to iterate, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost once steady.
- Primary workloads: nightly batch embed jobs (initially 200k/day, target 3M/day), and near-real-time semantic search for UI (peak ~800-1,200 qps during releases).

POC details / requirements:
- Embedding throughput: must support bulk batch ingestion (3M vectors/day target) with minimal operator overhead; want CSV/Parquet connector + direct S3 ingest path.
- Search latency: 95th pct < 200ms for semantic recall queries when routed through vector DB; P0 for UI.
- Vector DB integration: currently on Pinecone; evaluating move to self-hosted Milvus later. Need Redwood to export embeddings and support pulling embeddings via callback or push to their vector DB.
- Batch jobs: prefer orchestration hints (chunk sizes, continuations) + idempotency for retries.
- Model preferences: open-model embeddings (cost conscious) but will test Redwood-verified encoder models and quantized variants.

Early POC observations (hosted vs dedicated):
- Hosted API (baseline): easy onboarding, prototype completed in <48h, embedding throughput ok for dev. Cost for 1M vectors/day roughly in line with their threshold but spikes during bulk loads.
- Dedicated (small GPU pool): expected to reduce per-embed cost in steady state and lower tail latency for large batches. SE notes: GPU quantized runs expected ~6-12ms/vec for batched jobs (internal estimate).

Security/compliance:
- Must have SOC2 + SSO (SAML) + audit logs.
- Data residency: legal needs confirmation for storing snippets/embeddings in EU if EU customer data is present.

Commercials & blockers:
- Customer is cost-sensitive; wants clear unit economics (per-embed, per-query) and a simple transition path from Hosted to Dedicated without rework to pipelines.
- Blockers: security sign-off (SAML metadata), exact cost comparison vs Pinecone for steady-state 3M/day job, confirmation on EU residency for a subset of customers.

Quotes from calls:
- "We want to iterate fast on Hosted, but our finance team will only sign for Dedicated if the TCO is clear after month 1-2 of usage."
- "Nightly jobs need to be reliable — retries must be idempotent. We cannot afford duplication or missing vectors during backfills."

Next steps (short):
- Run Dedicated POC benchmark: ingest 500k vectors/day over 48h on small dedicated pool, measure cost/latency and failure modes. (Maya to provision test pool).
- AE to deliver pricing proposal and draft SOW by 2025-04-10.
- Legal call to confirm EU residency requirement and finalize SAML exchange.

Drive links & artifacts: pricing worksheet, security FAQ, Fireflies transcripts listed above.

AE notes (internal):
- Good technical sponsor (Head of Data), friendly exec sponsor but finance is conservative. High chance to convert if Dedicated POC shows >=30% cost reduction on per-embed basis and latency SLOs met.
- Recommend offering 30-day discounted Dedicated trial + migration assistance checklist to reduce procurement friction.
